text:
nina: FYI planning a short quiet window for the analytics release at 00:30 PT on Friday. Requesting silent corridor 00:15-01:45 PT. Need canary + rollback owners, and the pin plan by EOD. Release note: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.3.0 :sunglasses:

kevin: I can take canary ownership and watch nshard perf. I'll be online 00:00-01:00 PT.

tara: Rollback lead here. If we hit sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 4m or p99 +200ms for 5m, start rollback protocol.

nina: Ops checklist (short):
```
- Reserve 3x GPUs for canary (start T-30)
- Start warmup for routes: /analytics, /batch-embed, /insights (10m each)
- Run smoke: auth + billing + sampling (2 rounds)
- Traffic progression: 1% -> 3% -> 7% with verification steps
- Pin plan: pin to tag v3.3.0 at T+50s after canary stable
- Rollback exec: pre-approved command + unpin step ready
```

kevin: Smoke command (paste):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"llm-redwood:v3.3.0","input":"smoke analytics"}'
```

deploy-bot: Quiet window reserved by @nina. Queued actions: reserve-pool, warmup, pin (manual approve). Use `/deploy status 6141592653` to track. :robot_face:

ryan (oncall): I'll lower alert thresholds for the window and watch SLOs. Pager is on. Set 5xx alert at 0.4% and p99 +120ms.

tara: Rollback command (pre-acknowledged): `deploy rollback model:llm-redwood --to-tag=v3.2.4 --reason="urgent-rollback"` then `deploy unpin model:llm-redwood`. I'll authorize immediate exec if triggers hit.

kevin: Can we enable KV-cache prefill for `/analytics` top keys? That dropped cold starts last time. I can push patch T-20.

nina: Yes, please. Add exact keys in-thread so we can audit the change.

kevin: Adding keys: user:recent_queries, job:top-embeds, session:hot-ids. Pushing prefill at 00:10 PT.

deploy-bot: Canary pool started: pool-ae-12. Instances: 3. Health checks passing. req cb-6141592653-1

kevin: Initial 1% traffic routed. Monitoring latency and token-cost.

ryan (oncall): Seeing a small blip in tail latency on /batch-embed at T+8m. Monitoring.

kevin: blip looks transient; tracing shows downstream DB retry spike. Not model-related.

nina: Final call: owners confirmed (kevin canary, tara rollback, ryan monitoring). Pin queued. If no objections, we'll post T-15 reminder and proceed. :thumbsup:

tara: All set from my side.

ryan (oncall): Ready to respond.

nina: Thanks team 1. Will post T-15 and then T-5 before the quiet corridor starts.
